caption: The drawing depicts three rectangular boxes, two of which are situated at the bottom, open to reveal their interiors, and one is closed and placed at the top. All the boxes are covered on the outside with a colorful, ornate patterned paper featuring shades of green, blue, brown, and red, with white highlights forming stylized floral and leaf motifs. The interiors of the open boxes are lined with printed newspaper pages, with visible columns of text in a serif font. The boxes and their lids have a rigid, structured form and are depicted against a blank, beige background. There are no other objects present in the composition. In the bottom right corner of the drawing, the name "E. Buechner" is lightly inscribed.
title: Pa. German Wallpaper Box
